title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. translated_title: 通用表示，专家检测：面向时间序列异常检测的TS-Router
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）难以在不同数据集之间泛化，因为异构的时间动态蕴含着不同的“正常性”概念，并且偏好不同的检测准则。虽然时间序列基础模型能够提供可迁移的表示，但将其与固定的异常评分机制耦合可能会忽视这种差异。这启发了一种基于基础模型的TSAD的新视角：利用基础模型来协调专门的异常检测准则，而非直接强加一个通用准则。基于这一观点，我们提出了TS-Router，一个“通用表示、专家检测”框架，它从预训练的时间表示中估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，并为每个目标序列选择合适的专家。为了避免依赖真实任务中的专家性能标签，我们从专家的相对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TS-Router框架，利用时间序列基础模型提供的通用表示来估计多个异构异常检测器的相对能力，并为每个目标序列路由选择最合适的专家检测器，从而解决时间序列异常检测难以跨数据集泛化的问题。
en_tdlr: TS-Router is a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that uses pretrained foundation-model temporal representations to estimate the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors and routes each target series to the most suitable specialist, enabling better cross-dataset generalization in time-series anomaly detection.
